nodes.title: FET Phase
nodes.description: Further Education and Training Phase (Grades 10-12)

nodes.title: Mathematical Literacy
nodes.description: Mathematical Literacy — Grade 10 — CAPS Curriculum

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: SBA: Investigation and controlled test

nodes.title: Numbers and Calculations with Numbers
nodes.description: Number formats, operations, rounding, ratio, rates and percentage

nodes.title: Number formats
nodes.description: Decimal point, comma, thousand separators, positive/negative numbers, conversions between number formats

nodes.title: Operations
nodes.description: Operations with whole numbers and decimals with/without calculator (BODMAS); square, cube and square root; operations with fractions

nodes.title: Rounding, ratio, rates and percentage
nodes.description: Rounding to specified decimal places and nearest whole number; ratios (situations, formats, calculations); rates (meaning, types, calculations); percentage notation and calculations; percentage increase and decrease

nodes.title: Patterns, Relationships and Representations
nodes.description: Patterns and relationships, and their multiple representations

nodes.title: Patterns and relationships
nodes.description: Constant, direct proportion, and inverse proportion relationships; tables with input and output values

nodes.title: Representations
nodes.description: Tables with dependent/independent values and variables; equations; graphs; interpretation of tables and graphs; determine dependent/independent values, variables, zero/min/max/missing values; write story from graph or draw graph from story

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Developing questions, collecting, organising, summarising and analysing data

nodes.title: Collecting and organising data
nodes.description: Developing questions, collecting data, classifying and organising data

nodes.title: Summarising and analysing data
nodes.description: Mean, median, mode and range; analyse data represented by these measures

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of Numbers, Patterns and Data Handling

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: SBA: Assignment and mid-year exam

nodes.title: Finance
nodes.description: Financial documents, tariff systems and their graphical representations

nodes.title: Financial documents
nodes.description: Household bills, shopping documents, banking documents, household budget; relevant terminology

nodes.title: Tariff systems
nodes.description: Municipal, telephone, transport tariffs and bank fees; calculate cost using tariff/formula; draw and interpret graphs of various tariff systems

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.description: Unit conversions and measuring/estimating quantities

nodes.title: Conversions
nodes.description: Metric system; conversion using factors and tables; time formats and conventions

nodes.title: Measuring and estimating
nodes.description: Length, distance, weight/mass, volume, temperature and time; calculate costs of products and services

nodes.title: Maps, Plans and Other Representations
nodes.description: Scale and map skills

nodes.title: Scale
nodes.description: Use scale in form 1:500 and bar scales to calculate actual distance and length

nodes.title: Maps
nodes.description: Describe position of objects, find location, follow and develop directions, direction indicators, house numbering, numbering systems for seating in sport stadiums

nodes.title: Probability
nodes.description: Expression of probability, prediction, relative frequency and theoretical probability, tree diagrams and two-way tables

nodes.title: Expression of probability, events and outcomes
nodes.description: Expression of probability, events and outcomes, prediction

nodes.title: Relative frequency and theoretical probability
nodes.description: Relative frequency and theoretical probability

nodes.title: Tree diagrams and two-way tables
nodes.description: Tree diagrams and two-way tables

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: SBA: Assignment and controlled test

nodes.title: Finance
nodes.description: Income, expenditure, interest, taxation, banking, loans and investments

nodes.title: Income, expenditure, profit and loss
nodes.description: Perform calculations, identify fixed/variable/occasional income and expenditure, analyse and prepare income-and-expenditure statements and budgets

nodes.title: Interest
nodes.description: Distinguish between interest rate and interest; calculate interest and interest rate without formulae

nodes.title: Taxation
nodes.description: Determine VAT in context of shop purchases, till slips and bills; calculate VAT inclusive and exclusive prices

nodes.title: Banking, loans and investments
nodes.description: Understand terminology, determine bank charges for different account types, draw graphs from bank charges

nodes.title: Measurement
nodes.description: Perimeter and area of 2D shapes

nodes.title: Perimeter and area
nodes.description: Calculate perimeter and area of rectangles, triangles, circles (quarter, semi, three-quarters) using provided formulae; cost of products

nodes.title: Maps, Plans and Other Representations
nodes.description: Floor plans, assembly diagrams, models and packaging

nodes.title: Floor plans and design
nodes.description: Understand symbols/notation, describe representations, analyse layout, determine actual length using scale, determine quantity of material needed, draw 2D floor plans

nodes.title: Assembly diagrams, models and packaging
nodes.description: Assembly diagrams, models, packaging for optimal use of space, cost-effective packaging

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: No SBA task; Internal Examinations (Paper 1 75 marks 1.5h; Paper 2 75 marks 1.5h)

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Representing and analysing data using graphs

nodes.title: Representing data
nodes.description: Pie chart (interpretation only), histogram, single bar graph, line and broken line graph

nodes.title: Analysing data from graphs
nodes.description: Analyse data represented by pie charts, histograms, bar graphs, line and broken line graphs

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of Finance, Data Handling, Probability, Measurement, Maps and Plans

nodes.title: Internal Examinations
nodes.description: Paper 1: 75 marks, 1.5 hours (Finance, Data Handling, Probability integration); Paper 2: 75 marks, 1.5 hours (Maps/Plans, Measurements, Probability integration)
